revision_note: v3: adds AVAILABILITY layer (dual-track method, 2026-08-09). v2 corrected 4 orders edges to defended (real-chain Future.get 5s). v3 adds deployment-availability track: single-replica no-PDB services total-outage on kill (front-end 130s, orders 56s) - the same judgment template applied to the availability dimension, verified independently of ChaosEater.

availability_layer.method: static manifest (replicas/pdb/probes) + PodChaos pod-kill runtime (500ms Ready sampling)
availability_layer.summary: 8/8 Sock Shop business services are single-replica with no PDB and no HPA -> any single pod kill = total outage (AD-REDUNDANCY-001). Runtime-verified on 4: front-end (130s), orders (56s), user (155s), carts/shipping (0s window = no readiness gate, new pod marked Ready immediately). All min_ready=0.
availability_layer.note: outage_window varies: services WITH readiness probes (front-end/orders/user) show tens-of-seconds outage (probe gate + slow start); services WITHOUT probes (carts/shipping) show ~0s window because the new pod is marked Ready the instant it Runs - a gate-lack artifact, NOT fast self-heal. Absolute recovery times include image cache/load; relative conclusion (single-replica kill always hits a full-outage moment) holds for all 4.
